meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘:安装 npm 包、复制 pusher 模块与测试、把它接入 index.ts 的 main(),并配置 .env。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 加监控仪表盘、运行 /add-dashboard,或调整 DASHBOARD_SECRET、DASHBOARD_PORT 时接管。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个监控仪表盘
say.note: 会安装包、复制 pusher 并接入 main()

say.text: 仪表盘报 401,帮我检查 DASHBOARD_SECRET
say.note: 会对照 .env 与请求头排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw: installs the npm package, copies the pusher module and its tests, wires startDashboard() into main() in index.ts, and sets the .env vars.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, run /add-dashboard, or adjust DASHBOARD_SECRET or DASHBOARD_PORT.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the package, copies the pusher, wires main()

say_en.text: Run /add-dashboard and confirm the dashboard is live
